identification: Carved and painted wooden mountain climber (Tyrolean boy in green hat, brown jacket, lederhosen, knee socks, black boots) climbing a yellow synthetic rope, holding by a hook a sheet-metal pyramid-roof lantern with amber glass panes; novelty hanging/swag light, 56 cm. Carving is smooth and simplified (glossy stained finish, generic face), consistent with a later 20th c. export-made copy (likely Asian-made, Philippines/Indonesia type) of the German Black Forest 'Bergsteiger' climber lamp, not a fine German original. Estimate 50-75, no bid shown.

viewing_check: Is the figure solid carved wood (weight, tool marks) or resin? Look for any 'Made in Germany/Austria/W. Germany' or Philippines/Taiwan label under the boots or on the lantern; check whether a flex runs through the rope to the lantern and its condition; chips to paint on hat feather and fingers.
